mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS id, u.dept_id AS 'deptId', u.tenant_id AS 'tenantId', u.username AS 'username', u.`password` AS 'password', u.real_name AS 'realName', u.nickname AS 'nickname', u.email as 'email', u.avatar AS 'avatar', u.super_admin AS 'superAdmin', u.`status` AS 'status', u.gender AS 'gender' FROM sys_user AS u WHERE u.username = #{username}

SELECT u.id AS id, u.dept_id AS 'deptId', u.tenant_id AS 'tenantId', u.username AS 'username', u.`password` AS 'password', u.real_name AS 'realName', u.nickname AS 'nickname', u.email as 'email', u.avatar AS 'avatar', u.super_admin AS 'superAdmin', u.`status` AS 'status', u.gender AS 'gender' FROM sys_user AS u WHERE u.email = #{email}
